purpose: The one place that says which Node majors the runtime-matrix gate requires, and how to obtain them. tools/runRuntimeMatrix.mjs and test/runtime-matrix-coverage.test.js both read this file, so the generator cannot succeed on coverage its own build-blocking test rejects (revision-6 repair, Break 5 / M-3 / R6-I).
declaredCompatibilityNote: package.json `engines.node`. This is the range the project claims to RUN on. It is NOT a claim about which majors were executed — see `executedMajors` in audit/runtime-matrix.json for that, and never describe a subset as 'every supported Node major'.
requiredMajorsNote: The majors the gate requires evidence from. Chosen as the majors this project's evidence runs are performed on; extending the list is a deliberate edit here, and the generator then fails until those runtimes are present.

acquisition.preferred: Set LINEAGE_NODE_BINARIES to a colon-separated list of node binaries, e.g. LINEAGE_NODE_BINARIES=/usr/local/n/versions/node/20.20.2/bin/node:/usr/local/n/versions/node/22.22.2/bin/node
acquisition.nvm: nvm install 20 && nvm install 21 && nvm install 22, then the generator finds them under $NVM_DIR/versions/node/*/bin/node
acquisition.container: for m in 20 21 22; do docker run --rm -v "$PWD":/w -w /w node:$m npm test; done
acquisition.ci: a matrix job over node-version: [20, 21, 22] running `npm run audit:tests` and `npm run audit:runtime-matrix`
acquisition.note: Revision 5 discovered runtimes only under /opt/nodeNN, a layout private to one build machine. On any other machine the generator found a single runtime, exited 0, and recorded runtime independence from one sample — which its own test then rejected.
